summary: Two-step delegation wrapper. First calls sub_5117C8(a1, a2), then calls CallbackDispatch(a1, &stack_buffer) and returns the resulting function pointer. The 80-byte stack buffer v3 is used only as an output area for the dispatch call; its contents and the meaning of a1/a2 are unknown.

operations.description: Call sub_5117C8(a1, a2) — first step of the two-step delegation, consuming the caller-supplied arguments.
Call CallbackDispatch(a1, &v3) with a pointer to an 80-byte stack buffer as the second argument; its return value becomes the returned function pointer.
Return the function pointer produced by CallbackDispatch.

unresolved: Purpose and contents of the 80-byte stack buffer v3 passed to CallbackDispatch.
Meaning of arguments a1 and a2.
What the returned function pointer is used for; semantics of the produced delegate.
